transcript.content: Hello, please make yourself comfortable. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I came in because... honestly, ever since I moved into this busted-up room I'm renting, everything's just been off. I'm snapping at people all the time. I end up staying up half the night trying to fix leaks or get the heat working, and then... then I just drag myself into work late. And I'm messing up stuff on the site that I normally handle with no problem. It's just getting to be too much.
Aside from the stress with the room, have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?

No, not really. I mean, I wouldn't say I'm walking around sad all day or anything like that. It's more just... I'm just stressed and aggravated, you know? I don't feel depressed most of the day, it's just the whole situation with the room is really wearing me out and making me short-tempered.
Besides the problems with your room, do you find yourself worrying excessively about many different things in your life?

No, it's really just the room. I mean, my job is fine, my friends are fine. I'm not sitting around worrying about my health or my family or money... well, I mean, beyond the normal stuff anyway. It's just this one thing that's constantly on my back. If I could just get a decent place to sleep where the roof doesn't leak, I'd be fine.

latest_inference.note: Ruled out F41.1 (Generalized anxiety disorder) as worrying is not widespread or excessive about multiple domains, and ruled out F41.9 and F51.0 given the symptoms are clearly an adjustment reaction directly tied to an identifiable stressor.
